0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 4th in the Southeast and 13th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-0, 2nd in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East) having lost both of their games so far. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost the season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture).
